about_the_game:
Best Selection Vol.4 — a curated set of tracks from the paid DLCs of MASH VP! Re:VISION, now available at an affordable price!

Featuring a selection of challenging, high-difficulty tracks for players who want a real test of skill — plus an exclusive bonus track only included in this DLC!

The following songs will be added to “FREEPLAY” mode!

  • Xemetis -RiraN REMIX- / Tatsh

  • Odyssey / siqlo

  • Axtorchy / zz

  • XROSS BASS / Quarkee

《本DLC限定ボーナストラック》

  • Dark Fenix Revive / LUST DESIRE

  • CYBER-kyoto- 葵祭2045 / Re-venG

※This DLC includes some tracks originally featured in MASH VP! Re:VISION – AXTORM SOUND RELATION -I- beginning, MASH VP! Re:VISION – Bridging to Emotion, and MASH VP! Re:VISION – GENESiS RE:BUiLD 03 STARDUST.

Tracks that appear in multiple DLC packs can be played as long as you own any one of the DLCs containing them.
